svg.text: S-T041.1 top1 failure: receptor-centered CA trace comparison
Gray = receptor chain A, colored = ligand chain B. Positive definition: fnat > 0.3.
min CA-chain distance=4.4 Å CA contacts<8Å=52
min CA-chain distance=76.7 Å CA contacts<8Å=0
min CA-chain distance=4.4 Å CA contacts<8Å=34
Cause: the failed TraDock top1 has no native contacts (fnat=0) and huge RMSD, but its MDN score is 0.0. In the scoring code, poses with no
interface pairs return 0.0; normal log-likelihood scores are negative, so 0.0 can be incorrectly ranked first.
